severe_errors.description: Selected clip does not support its narrative beat.
Missing required footage is silently filled with unrelated material.
A rights-blocked source enters the approved timeline.
A required dialogue or action is cut before comprehension.
Narration changes unsupported identity, event, causality or motivation.
Narration repeatedly restates clearly audible dialogue without purpose.
Crop removes a key face, action, text or violates safe composition.
Required minimum beat durations exceed the approved target.
